manuscript_campaign_scope: 13,920 conditions per system; recorded histories are in optimization/current/runs
initial_design: uniform random without replacement; identical indices for paired BO and random runs
surrogate: Bayesian linear regression with normal-inverse-gamma prior, expressed as a finite feature kernel
observed_response_transform: center and scale only currently revealed responses; unit scale if constant
acquisition: posterior latent mean + 1.96 * posterior latent standard deviation
batch_selection: posterior updated between batches; top 12 UCB conditions selected together within each batch with seeded random tie-breaking
feature_groups_panel: SMILES token-count descriptors and simple structural token descriptors, standardized over the supplied diagnostic panel rows
metrics: batch-end budget to the exact best row in the supplied diagnostic table
batch-end budget to 95 percent of the best response in the supplied diagnostic table
batch-end budget to actual route condition
paired mean budget saving and bootstrap interval
stopping: diagnostic enumeration of all supplied panel or slice rows; manuscript campaign stopping is defined in optimization/current/protocol.json
exclusions: PL30 records with different protocols and all substrate-expansion rows excluded from optimization; retained in data audit
scope: archived source-panel and representative plate-slice diagnostics; manuscript campaigns rank the complete 13,920-condition space and are deposited in optimization/current/runs
implementation_note: The implemented finite feature kernel is X @ X.T with no independent random-intercept variance. The historical intercept_variance_factor field is not used by bo_core.posterior; revealed responses are centered at each update.
